description: This source file defines attribute classes used to specify storage and log consistency providers for grains in Orleans. It contains the attributes StorageProviderAttribute and LogConsistencyProviderAttribute, each allowing customization of provider names for grain persistence and consistency.

classes.name: StorageProviderAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to specify the storage provider for grain persistence, defaulting to 'Default'.

classes.name: LogConsistencyProviderAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to specify the log consistency provider for grains using log-view state.

methods.name: StorageProviderAttribute()
methods.description: Constructor initializing ProviderName to default storage provider name.

methods.name: LogConsistencyProviderAttribute()
methods.description: Constructor initializing ProviderName to default log consistency provider name.
